verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
From the rising of the sun
To the setting of the same
Jesus, Your name is
Worthy of unceasing worship
From the rising of the sun
To the setting of the same
Jesus, Your name is
Worthy of unending love

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
We pour our love on You
We pour our love on You

verse.name: e1
verse.lines:
Let the fragrance of our worship
be pleasing
Let the fragrance of our worship
be pleasing to You

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
You pour Your love on us
You pour Your love on us

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
We pour our love on You
Cause You pour Your love on us
